metadata.article_title: Presentment for payment of instrument payable after date or sight

article.title: Presentment for payment of instrument payable after date or sight
article.content: A promissory note or bill of exchange, made payable at a specified period after date or sight thereof, must be presented for payment at maturity.
article.html:
66Presentment for payment of instrument payable after date or sight

Section 66 · Chapter V · page 17 of the Act

A promissory note or bill of exchange, made payable at a specified period after date or sight thereof, must be presented for payment at maturity.
